query: SELECT t.thread_id AS "thread_id!: String", COALESCE(w.start_epoch, p.start_epoch) AS "start_epoch: i64", COALESCE(w.start_position, p.start_position) AS "start_position: i64", COALESCE(w.active, p.active, 0) AS "active!: i64" FROM threads t LEFT JOIN thread_watches w ON w.reader = ? AND w.thread_id = t.thread_id LEFT JOIN project_watches p ON p.reader = ? WHERE t.thread_id > ? AND COALESCE(w.active, p.active, 0) != 0 ORDER BY t.thread_id LIMIT ?
